context_for_next_testing_agent: TRACK 15.75A is a pure read-expansion fix in /app/backend/pm_routing.py (resolve_pm_for_record_async + recipients_for_record_async) and /app/backend/routes/admin_pm_coverage.py. Legacy jobs_master.pm_email ALWAYS wins when present; roster (project_team_assignments where assignment_role='pm', is_primary=True, active=True) is the authoritative fallback; co-PMs are unioned. Inactive / non-primary roster rows are ignored. The live preview DB currently shows 7 missing-pm-email rows including 20-07 and 26-07; their roster rows have an active primary PM but the PM's user_directory/employees row does not carry a resolvable email yet -- so the rows still show status='pm_email_blank' (not pm_email_ok_via_roster). This is consistent with the spec: pm_email_ok_via_roster is only emitted when the roster ACTUALLY resolves to a usable email. Main agent should not interpret the all-blank status as a regression -- the test suite covers the resolve-success path and it passes.

live_endpoint_verification.note_on_pm_email_ok_via_roster_status: Not observed in any current missing row because the roster's active primary PM rows for these projects do not yet resolve to a concrete email via user_directory/employees in the preview DB. Spec wording is MAY -- not required. The pm_routing unit test test_roster_pm_resolves_when_legacy_blank covers the resolution path end-to-end and passes.
